attachments.name: medical_plan.txt
attachments.text:
EVENT MEDICAL PLAN
Tanners Row Founders Race 5K, Sunday 19 September 2027
Applicant: Tanners Row Business Association
Issue: 2.0

1. Event summary
A 5K race with 100 runners, starting at 09:30 in the Greenhill area of Port Halden. No ambulance will be stationed at the race; any ambulance would come through the 911 system.

2. First aid cover
3 first aid posts will operate, at the start, at the finish and at the course midpoint, staffed by 6 qualified first aiders. Posts are placed so that no part of the course is more than 1.5 km from one. Two cycle responders move along the course with defibrillators.

3. Weather and hydration
Water is available every 2.5 km. The race director checks the forecast 48 hours and 2 hours before the start. Above 28 degrees C the start is brought forward or the course shortened, and above 32 degrees C the race is cancelled. In cold or wet conditions, foil blankets and a warm shelter are at the finish.

4. Transfer to hospital
The receiving hospital is Port Halden General Hospital, 2 km from the finish. The transfer route and the pick-up point at the top of Albion Road have been walked with the first aid team. The hospital's emergency department has been told the date and the expected numbers.

5. Communications
Every first aid post and cycle responder carries a radio on the medical channel, with phones as backup. All calls for an ambulance go through the medical lead, who gives the crew the access point and the nearest barrier to open.

In recent years the last runner has usually finished well inside the time limit, and past incidents have been limited to a few blisters and one twisted ankle. A number of members have first aid certificates from work and are glad to be there in a general helping role.

6. Clinical lead
The medical lead is Nadia Petrov, a registered paramedic, who is on site from an hour before the start until the last runner is cleared. The lead can have any runner withdrawn on medical grounds.

attachments.name: race_plan.txt
attachments.text:
RACE PLAN
Tanners Row Founders Race 5K | Sunday 19 September 2027
Organiser: Tanners Row Business Association
Race director: Rhys Morgan
Reference: AG-52077

Overview
The Tanners Row Founders Race 5K is a 5K race of 5 km for 100 entrants, based in the Greenhill area of Port Halden. The start is at 09:30 and the course closes at 10:45.

Course
The course runs in order along Albion Road, Halden Way, Mill Road and Vine Street, all of which are closed to traffic for the race. Major roads crossed: none. The finish is in Clocktower Square.

Course dimensions
The course uses wide carriageways throughout. Albion Road offers 11 m kerb to kerb, Mill Road about 16 m and Vine Street about 16 m, with footways of a further 3 m on each side. The field assembles on Albion Road, and the finish is in Clocktower Square, an open paved area of around one and a half hectares.

Support
Entrants collect numbers from the top of Albion Road from one hour before the start. Timing is by chip, with mats at the start and finish. Results are posted on the Tanners Row website the same day.

attachments.name: traffic_plan.txt
attachments.text:
Traffic arrangements for the Tanners Row Founders Race 5K, Sunday 19 September 2027

From Rhys Morgan, Race Director, Tanners Row Business Association

We have tried to think through what happens on the roads on race day. The race is a 5K, it starts at 09:30, and it goes through the Greenhill area. Police attendance is covered in the attached correspondence.

The route has changed little from last time. Where it has changed, we have tried to keep a clear run for the field, and we welcome any comments from the Events Office on how signed diversions are usually handled in the city.

Closing the roads
We need the following closures, and Signal Hill Traffic Services will put out the barriers and signs for us. Albion Road from Brook Street to Tanner Street, 08:15 until 11:15. Halden Way from Tanner Street to Copper Row, 08:15 until 11:15. Mill Road from Rope Walk to Spring Way, 08:15 until 11:15. Vine Street from Spring Way to Copper Row, 08:15 until 11:15.

Crossings
We don't cross any major roads on this route, so there's nothing special to arrange here.

Getting around the closures
We've worked out the way round for drivers and Signal Hill Traffic Services will sign it. Traffic off Albion Road goes via Station Road and Dock Road, signed from Spring Way. Traffic off Halden Way goes via Dock Road and High Street, signed from Rope Walk. Traffic off Mill Road goes via High Street and Prince Street, signed from Tanner Street. Traffic off Vine Street goes via Church Road and Station Road, signed from Rope Walk.

Emergency vehicles
We keep one lane clear the whole way, 3.5 metres or more, for ambulances and fire engines. Every barrier has someone with a radio on our channel, and they can have it open within two minutes. Our controller on the day has direct numbers for police and ambulance control.

Letting people know
Every house and shop on the closed streets gets a letter three weeks before and a reminder a week before. We'll put up the yellow notice boards ten days ahead, and we've told the bus company the times.

Afterwards
Our sweep vehicle follows the last runner, and each closure comes off in turn once it has passed and the road is clear. Everything will be open again by 11:15.
